Method of Attack: Android banking trojan with overlays on apps to steal credentials
Intercepts SMS messages and USSD codes to defeat two-step verification
Steals credentials from multiple apps, not just banking apps
Uses obfuscation to evade Google Play Store malware scanners
Uses web-based backend for communication and reporting infected devices
Packaged to allow easy creation of fake overlays by malware authors
Impacted Systems: Russian banks (targeted by early BankBot versions)
Attack Vector: Apps uploaded to Google Play Store with obfuscated malware code
Underground hacking forums (Exploit.in) for tutorial and source code distribution
